profile.headline: EDI Developer @ Hansen Technologies |⚡Energy Industry | EDI, Cleo Clarify
profile.summary:
EDI Integration Specialist • Cross-Industry EDI Expertise • Cleo Clarify & Harmony Expert • Approachable Mentor & Knowledge Resource

I’m a senior-level EDI integration specialist and software developer with a strong track record of implementing and supporting scalable, compliant solutions across high-volume environments in the energy, food distribution, aerospace, and chemical industries. My experience includes extensive work with the Cleo EDI platform, including Clarify, Harmony, and ESX, as well as legacy and modern integration tools. I’ve contributed to migrations, trading partner onboarding, and custom development across diverse business settings, including configuring InsideAgent for energy market communications.

I’m fluent in ANSI X12 800-Series transaction sets, including 214, 248, 568, 810, 814, 820, 824, 832, 850, 855, 856, 860, 867, and 997/999. My work spans key business processes such as Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). I’ve supported AS2, SFTP, FTP, HTTPS, and VAN connections, and worked with multiple file formats including EDI, XML, JSON, CSV, flat file, and database. In the energy sector, I’ve supported GISB and NAESB protocols for secure and compliant data exchange. I’m also expanding into healthcare EDI by learning transaction sets like 837 and 835.

I take a thoughtful, analytical approach to problem solving and have a strong record of production support and troubleshooting in EDI and AS2 environments. I’m known for delivering bug-free code by investing extra time in analysis, documentation, and testing. That thoroughness helps prevent downstream issues and builds trust across teams. I’m approachable and invested in helping others succeed. Colleagues often come to me with questions, not just about EDI, but about company systems, processes, and tools I’ve worked with. I share what I know and help others find what they need, which strengthens team performance and builds confidence across departments. To further support integration and troubleshooting, I’m expanding my scripting skills by learning Perl and Python.

My contributions span the full development lifecycle, including design, requirements gathering, coding, testing, documentation, implementation, and post-implementation support. I’ve worked in both Agile and Waterfall environments and bring additional skills in SQL and DB2 databases, RPGLE development on IBM i/AS400, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, and business process analysis and reengineering.

positions.title: Software Developer/EDI Specialist
positions.description:
• Supported energy sector clients using Cleo Clarify for EDI mapping and partner onboarding
• Worked with X12 sets including 568, 810, 814, 820, 824, 850, 855, 856, 867, and 997, along with XML, flat file, and database layouts
• Set up secure messaging protocols (HTTPS, SFTP, FTP) and configured InsideAgent for NAESB/GISB communications, including partner onboarding, certificate exchange, and payload validation
• Designed and programmed system modifications based on client requirements, identifying where custom logic was needed
• Collaborated with Business Analysts to clarify specs and ensure smooth handoff between design and development
• Created technical specification documents and supported other developers during component design
• Provided mentoring and cross-team support, helping colleagues troubleshoot issues and navigate Cleo tools with confidence
• Performed unit testing, diagnosed defects, and resolved integration issues across deliverables
• Promoted system updates to new and existing customers, supporting rollout and post-launch stability

Key Projects:
   ◦ Supported the migration of Exelon’s EDI operations from a legacy system to Hansen platforms, focusing on Cleo Clarify onboarding for PECO, BGE, PHI, Exelon Supply, and ComEd
   ◦ Joined the project as a consultant and was later hired directly by Hansen, remaining one of the few developers who saw the initiative through to completion
   ◦ Collaborated across teams to align EDI mapping with broader Hansen system architecture and ensure long-term stability for high-volume energy clients

positions.title: EDI Software Consultant (Contracted to Hansen Technologies)
positions.description:
• Joined Hansen Technologies via EDI Staffing to support the Exelon EDI migration initiative.
• Collaborated with a small team to build EDI maps, configure trading partner connections, and deploy integrations to test environments.
• Worked directly with Exelon stakeholders to validate transactions and ensure readiness for production.
• Supported go-live activities and provided hyper-care coverage, delivering rapid troubleshooting and fixes during the stabilization period.
• Demonstrated reliability and cross-functional value, leading to full-time hire by Hansen Technologies.

Note: Continued in full-time role at Hansen Technologies following contract completion.

positions.title: EDI Consultant
positions.description:
EDI Specialist consulting for Gordon Food Service

• Supported GFS’s EDI team in an Agile environment using JIRA, xMatters, and ServiceNow to manage onboarding and support tasks.
• Set up Cleo Clarify projects and Harmony AS2 connections for new trading partners—handled requirements, testing, and go-live coordination.
• Acted as the primary contact for vendor-side EDI support, resolving or escalating issues across AS2 and VAN connections.
• Monitored daily production traffic and addressed errors in real time to maintain SLA performance.
• Translated maps from GXS Workbench to Cleo Clarify and built new maps in XML, JSON, flat file, and database formats.
• Supported X12 sets including 214, 810, 850, 855, 856, and 997 across vendor and customer workflows.
• Maintained trading partner reference docs and updated internal support databases.

Key projects:
    ◦ Migrating EDI maps from GXS to Cleo Clarify
    ◦ Migrating AS2 transactions from GXS to Cleo Harmony
    ◦ Onboarding 75 trading partners across EDI and AS2
    ◦ Implementing vendor-side ASN (856) flows

• Monitored daily EDI traffic, resolved errors, and worked directly with partners to troubleshoot operational issues.
• Modified RPGLE programs and supported CL scripts used in EDI workflows and job scheduling.
• Acted as a liaison between internal teams, vendors, and customers—clarifying specs and streamlining communication.
• Documented system designs and program logic to support long-term maintainability.

Key projects:

   ◦ Configuration of new Cleo Harmony environment
